Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production hand-drawn game character sprite atlas. Edit target: supplied rowan twenty-pose sheet.
Primary request: replace the CLOTHING/ARMOR ONLY with a COMPLETE fitted steel chainmail and articulated plate outfit worn over the hero's own colored tunic: anatomically fitted breastplate, natural curved pauldrons, segmented vambraces, linked chain skirt, proper waist belt. Steel hugs the torso and bends with shoulders, elbows and waist. Refined brushed iron and restrained brass trim, not a flat inventory icon.
CRITICAL: draw the armor as part of each COMPLETE CHARACTER'S BODY in all twenty poses. Every breastplate, shoulder, sleeve and waist follows the person's anatomy, perspective and gesture. No separate wearable layer, detached item, mannequin, hanger, icon or loose armor floating over the body.
Preserve EXACTLY the same hero identity, hairstyle/hair color, skin tone, build, body proportions, facing direction and the EXACT same TWENTY poses in the EXACT same reading order, FOUR COLUMNS × FIVE ROWS. Preserve the pose silhouettes and hand positions: ready, draw, windup, contact, follow-through, recover, brace, parry, hurt, stagger, cast, heal, victory, kneeling defeat, six walk poses. Hands remain EMPTY for runtime weapon attachment.
Every human face MUST remain completely PLAIN: no eyes, eyebrows, nose shape/shadow, nostrils, mouth, lips or expression lines. Preserve hair and ears. Refined ink/gouache illustration with controlled clean contours and material detail matching reference.
Production composition: high resolution atlas, complete head-to-boot characters centered in regular cells, roughly same character pixel height as reference, clear transparent gutters around every silhouette at least 10% of each cell. No touching neighboring sprites or canvas edges, no cropped hands/feet/cape. Genuine transparent RGBA empty background. No text, labels, grid, scenery, ground, cast shadows or extra figures. Exactly20 complete sprites.
